render.stationsManifestPrelude: # atari800xl (slot 186) — Atari 800XL, host-native MAME a800xlp, boot menu of period software; atari800xl wave 2026-09-08.

eraSoftware: Atari BASIC rev C (the machine's built-in language, ROM-resident)
museum.blurb: The Atari 8-bit most people owned: a 64 KB 800XL with Atari BASIC in ROM, a 1050 disk drive on the SIO bus and a joystick on port 1. The disk boots straight into a menu — Star Raiders, River Raid and The Last Word word processor.
museum.notes: Host-native station: MAME 0.289's a800xlp driver (Atari 800XL, PAL) runs on the host — drawshm frames, ctlsock keys, FIFO audio, no QEMU and no guest OS. -flop1 is hive.atr, a 90 KB single-density MyDOS disk composed on the host by scripts/build-guests/tiles/atari800xl.sh; its boot sector is MyPicoDos 4.06N, whose boot screen IS the file menu (RETURN loads the highlighted entry, ~15 s per title). Keyboard-only exhibit (pointer transport none), like apple2e, with a CX40 joystick on -ctrl1 driven from the host arrow keys and Left Alt as fire; F1/F2/F3 are the Start/Select/Option console keys. Menu navigation is the PC arrow keys directly (MyPicoDos reads the joystick port the arrow keys are mapped to, no CTRL chord needed — measured, golden stream). The menu ships three titles (Star Raiders, River Raid, The Last Word); XBASIC.XEX (an exit to Atari BASIC) was removed 2026-09-08 — it never reached a BASIC READY prompt. See docs/lab/ATARI800XL-WAVE.md.

reset.mouse: N/A — keyboard-only exhibit (pointer transport none); see the wave brief's OPEN items

XBASIC.XEX was REMOVED from the menu this stream (never reached a BASIC READY prompt, three DOSINI/DOSVEC fixes tried by golden4, none clean -- see docs/lab/ATARI800XL-WAVE.md). reset.fixture: Atari 800XL, MAME 0.289 a800xlp running HOST-NATIVE (drawshm). MyPicoDos 4.06N boot menu on D1: (hive.atr, SINGLE density) lists LASTWORD.XEX, LW.CFG, RIVRRAID.XEX, STARRAID.XEX (alphabetical, four entries -- XBASIC.XEX was removed 2026-09-08, golden5 stream, it never reached a BASIC READY prompt); highlight starts on LASTWORD.XEX, a proven title. DROPZONE.XEX sits unreachable on a second single-density drive hive2.atr (D2:, -flop2 -- the drive-select key does not switch drives). Cold boot: directory fully painted by ~19 s. Reset is a relaunch that restores sta/a800xlp/golden.sta (rebaked 2026-09-08, golden5 stream, on the four-entry menu); the restore is PIXEL-IDENTICAL to the pre-capture frame. Menu navigation and RETURN-to-load are both PROVEN (see reset.keyboard); Dropzone remains open.

spine 2026-09-08: device set a800xlp (Atari 800XL PAL — a130xe is MACHINE_NOT_WORKING in 0.289, a800xl NTSC is the same driver), -sio a1050 (`-flop1..4` .atr/.xfd), -ctrl1 joy (CX40 joystick on port 1, driven from the keyboard's arrow keys + a fire key through keymap override rows), cartslot empty (built-in BASIC)

golden5 stream 2026-09-08: XBASIC.XEX removed from the menu -- RETURN on it never reached a BASIC READY prompt (three DOSINI/DOSVEC fixes tried by golden4, all worse than or equal to a plain return-to-menu), so it does not ship. demoProgram and keyboard.charMap/SH_KEY_MAP were added only to type into that XBASIC prompt and are removed with it -- the '=' key mapping (host `]` -> guest `=`) is now unproven and unshipped; see docs/lab/ATARI800XL-WAVE.md OPEN items.
